name: G6 T3 W07 - Measure and model an eraser
description: Study these five words across this week. Complete Flashcards, Matching and Fill in Blank once. Then choose additional practice. Reuse this pool throughout the week. Follow your separate class instructions.

words.definition: A measurement such as length, width or height.
words.example: Check each dimension of the model against the eraser.

words.definition: The measurement from one end of an object to the other.
words.example: The length of the eraser is 50 millimetres.

words.definition: The measurement from one side of an object to the other.
words.example: The width of the eraser is 20 millimetres.

words.definition: The measurement from the bottom of an object to its top.
words.example: The height of the eraser is 10 millimetres.

words.definition: A representation used to show what an object is like.
words.example: The digital model has the same dimensions as the eraser.
